text:
anya: Heads-up, bringing up Sumi v1.2 (q5mix quant profile) on staging. Quick smoke showed weird detokenization for mixed CJK+RTL inputs — zh+ar testcases failing BLEU by ~4 points.

matt: ugh. repro steps?

anya: repro is small. used locale-mix-suite v2, sample payload: 
```json
{\n  \"src\": \"今天输出: ٢٣٤٥\",\n  \"lang\": \"zh-ar_mixed\"\n}\n```
Output comes back with mirrored arabic numerals stuck to previous han char and a stray ZWJ inserted.

sung: any diffs vs fp32 run?

anya: yes — fp32 baseline looks clean. q5mix shows token offsets like: 
```
offsets: [0,1,2,3,4, -1, 5,6]
```
which implies an extra joiner at index -1 and strange reordering.

liang: can you paste a raw example response?

anya: raw from staging:
```
\"今天输出‍٢٣٤٥\"
```
Note the invisible char between 输出 and the arabic digits.

matt: that looks like ZWJ (U+200D). Could be our charset->tokenizer mapping when handling bidi runs. Did tokenization differ?

anya: tokenizer log: 
```
Sumi-v1.2-q5mix: tokens: [\\\"今天\\\", \\\"输出\\\", \\\"\\\", \\\"٢\\\", \\\"٣\\\", \\\"٤\\\", \\\"٥\\\"]
```
(weird null placeholder showing up)

sung: null placeholder probably from fallback byte sequence when merging multi-script graphemes. Maybe quant kernel changed bytepair boundary detection.

liang: run a quick compare: run tokenization on CPU fp32 and on quant model with the same input and dump raw bytes. I'll check byte alignment.

anya: started that: attach logs in a sec. Also seeing mirrored punctuation: closing bracket ) becomes mirrored in output when preceded by CJK.

matt: could be bidi shaping step running after detokenization in the quant path. We added a cheap postprocess for RTL punctuation to save cycles — might be incorrectly applied when previous char is wide (CJK).

liang: good call. which file has that optimization? I think commit 9f3b9 \"fast-bidi-postprocess\" in runtime.

anya: yep. staging build includes that. fp32 run used older runtime build.

matt: quick mitigation: flip the postprocess to check is_wide_char(prev) before applying RTL mirror and avoid inserting joiners. Can we patch on staging and retest?

deploy-bot: deploy request queued for eng-ml/staging -> patch/fast-bidi-guard by liang. ETA ~12m.

liang: patch pushed to patch/fast-bidi-guard. Also added a unit test mixing CJK+AR numbers and parentheses.

anya: re-run smoke after deploy.

(eva-bot): perf alert: q5mix kernel X shows +1.9% p50 latency after patch (bench harness).

liang: that's expected small overhead. prioritize correctness first, will micro-opt later.

matt: once we have correctness, we need to add this mixed-locale test to the onboarding gate for future quant bring-ups. Add to locale-mix-suite and to the nightly regression check.

anya: agreed. also filing a short postmortem note for model onboarding doc: mention potential runtime postprocess interactions and quant-specific tokenizer fallbacks.

matt: assign owners for follow-ups: liang -> patch + unit tests, sung -> add to onboarding gate + eval spec, anya -> update model bring-up checklist.

anya: thanks — will update checklist and add example snippets. For reproducibility, command I used: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging-eval.internal/run -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"sumi-v1.2-q5mix\",\"suite\":\"locale-mix-v2\",\"case\":\"zh_ar_numbers_01\"}'
```

liang: got it. i'll validate token-dumps and attach diff soon.

matt: nice catch, anya. :tada:

anya: :relieved: keep thread open until nightly passes.

(eva-bot): nightly regression job queued for locale-mix-suite v2 run.

liang: initial diff attached in CI run (see artifacts): token null placeholder removed, mirrored punctuation fixed. will monitor BLEU delta.

anya: local BLEU improved from -4.2 to -0.1 after patch. closing for now but keep on watch.

matt: please post a one-liner in #eng-ml when nightly green. will add to release notes if stable.
